name: 51106 · Sioux City, IA
findings: ZIP 51106 (Sioux City) has 98 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 51106 (Sioux City) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 51106 (Sioux City) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
